coverage.note: Drawn from OpenStreetMap, a crowd-sourced map — this is not a canvass of every county and will miss stores nobody has mapped yet, and may carry one that has since closed. A missing store is not evidence it does not exist; tell us and we will add it.
coverage.method: Overpass query for shop=games, shop=anime, shop=comic, shop=collector tagged collector~comic, and shop=computer, inside ISO3166-2=US-OH; named places only; OSM disused:shop entries dropped; city filled from OSM address tags or, when absent, a Nominatim reverse lookup; county assigned by point-in-polygon against data/ohio-counties.json.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (shop=games, shop=anime, shop=comic, shop=collector+collector~comic, shop=computer, inside ISO3166-2=US-OH)
